**Implementation note:** The put leg of ThetaGang's wheel; options are out of scope.

## Description

Sell cash-secured puts or a systematic index put-write strategy, reserving collateral for assignment.

## Where it may fit

Markets where option premium is attractive relative to realized downside and cash collateral is available.

## Vehicles

Put-write index strategies, options-income funds, conservative option overlays.

## Required data

Put option chain, implied volatility, rates, collateral yields, underlying total returns, assignment and costs.

## Caveats

The Cboe PUT reference describes a hypothetical collateralized index strategy; individual-stock puts have different assignment and concentration risks.
